model_meta.description: Ball screw assembly in which grooved shaft and nut engage through balls, with end-mounted circulation members returning balls through passages external to the nut.

subsystems.description: Metallic shaft with a first helical screw groove on its outer circumferential surface.

Cylindrical nut surrounding the shaft, with a second groove and end mounting portions. Each mounting portion is cut out in a three-sided shape on the outer circumference, extends to the nut's outermost axial end, and receives a main body fixed to the respective end surface without covering the entire end surface; the main body leaves an uncovered outermost end.

interfaces.interface_type: ball transfer between groove and first passage

subsystems.description: Rolling balls installed between the shaft and nut grooves and circulated during relative displacement.
End-mounted main body portions containing first return-passage sections connected to the nut groove; an interior-wall projection parallel to the circulation passage is provided.
Outward cylindrical portions connected to the circulation main bodies and containing the axial return passage section.

item_flows.name: Circulating steel balls
item_flows.notes: Balls travel in the engaged shaft/nut grooves and return through the main-body and cylindrical passage sections.

item_flows.name: Shaft rotation
item_flows.notes: The description explains that shaft rotation produces linear displacement of the nut through the balls.

item_flows.name: Nut axial displacement
item_flows.notes: The nut is displaced linearly along the shaft axis.

actions.name: Convert shaft rotation to nut displacement

steps.description: Shaft rotation is transmitted through the engaged balls and grooves to produce linear axial displacement of the nut.
Guide balls out of the nut groove through a passage in a circulation main body.
Complete ball circulation is provided by the connected circulation passage, including its axial section in the cylindrical portions.
Carry balls along the axial second passage in the connected cylindrical portions between the main-body passage sections.
